label: For every explicitly typed complete-history modal scenario, world and rigid candidate-individual…
paraphrase: For every explicitly typed complete-history modal scenario, world and rigid candidate-individual domain, a concrete individual that exists actually and is distinct from every actually existing contingent concretum exists exactly when a concrete individual exists actually and necessarily throughout the accessible worlds. This is a classical semantic equivalence: externality relative to the totality of contingents already carries the necessary-being commitment. The equivalence says nothing about causal powers, totality-level causation, whether any such candidate actually exists, or objective metaphysical possibility.
